commandOpaqueMask.rule: The command surface (red-triangle command UI on a fully OPAQUE full-viewport pane/command surface) must be fully opaque over the ENTIRE canvas from `start` (inside the stationary paneHold) through `end` and through the bundle swap until the first interactive frame is drawn. The camera moves from the pane stop to the interactive t=0 pose only inside phases.return (0.50 s), which must never be visible.
commandOpaqueMask.whyHidden: the opening starts centred on the pane axis (x=0.059688, y=0.136535), the interactive route starts at (0,0,0): reversing that offset would be a visible lateral/backwards return; it is therefore performed only while the command surface hides the world
